Drawdown ladder: scale, hysteresis boundary, exits_only, flatten_and_pause
cases.note: Confirmation and lift delays are 0 and max_daily_loss is 0.5 to isolate the ladder.

cases.title: Time-in-breach confirmation: short recoveries do not restart it
cases.note: exits_only rung at E <= 9870. In breach 14:02:00-14:02:45 (45 s) and from 14:02:50; the 5 s recovery is shorter than breach_confirm_s (60 s) so time accumulates: 45 + 20 = 65 s at 14:03:10.

cases.title: Recovery longer than breach_confirm_s restarts confirmation
Hard trigger at 1.25 x the rung: temporary exits_only, latched on a second quote
cases.note: exits_only hard level: H - E >= 1.25 x 0.06 x 10500 = 787.5, so E <= 9712.5. The first hard quote (14:02:05) applies a temporary exits_only; the second, 10 s later, latches the rung.

cases.title: Confirmation continues on clock ticks after the close
cases.note: Daily breach at 15:59:30 ET, the last regular-session mark. Breach time reaches 60 s after the close; the limit triggers at the first input at or after that (the 16:00:40 clock tick).

cases.title: A pending daily breach is resolved at the risk-day rollover
cases.note: The breach starts 30 s before midnight (breach_confirm_s 60). After the rollover it keeps confirming against the previous day's E0 and latches (resolved_at_rollover) once it has 60 s of breach time; it lifts at the next midnight.

cases.title: Daily loss: lift waits daily_breach_min_s after a late-night crypto breach
cases.note: 23:50 America/New_York is 03:50Z; daily_breach_min_s is 3600.

cases.title: New-day breach during the lift delay renews the latch
Acknowledgment: rejected while flattening; reset after flat; rungs lift one at a time
cases.note: After the reset both scale rungs are active; the higher rung (0.04, factor 0.5) lifts first after 600 s, then the lower.

cases.title: Lifetime floor with an inherited loss; cannot be acknowledged
Allocation changes scale H, E0, and the capital base; a withdrawal never trips the floor
cases.note: Reviewer counterexample: E = 9500, C = 10000; withdrawing 5000 used to set the floor to 4500 = E.

cases.title: Allocation rejected: increase while latched; decrease below exposure
Session marks ignored; failed and missing marks set a per-instrument stale restriction
cases.note: mark_max_age_s is 120 s of regular-session time.

cases.title: Daily flatten_and_pause: acknowledgment after flat leaves exits_only until the next day
Ladder and daily loss in one step; the stricter mode holds after the daily lift
on_complete disarm_ladder: holding with the ladder and daily loss disarmed; floor stays armed
cases.note: E = 10000 + 0.15 x (mark - 55000). At 50600 DD = 0.066 (would be exits_only) and daily -6.6%; disarmed. At 48000 E = 8950 <= floor 9000.

cases.title: on_complete release: positions released and the agent retires
Flatten hard trigger needs a second quote: exits_only first, flatten 10 s later
cases.note: Flatten hard level: H - E >= 1.25 x 0.08 x 10500 = 1050, so E <= 9450. The exits_only rung hard-triggers at once; the flatten needs the hard level on a quote at least min(breach_confirm_s, 10) = 10 s after the first.

cases.title: A single flash print does not flatten
A flash breach just before midnight is discarded after the rollover
Loosening a latched floor: waiting period, insufficient, then lifted
cases.note: Floor 9000 at f = 0.1; E = 9000 latches it. Raising f to 0.2 moves the floor to 8000 (E > 8000, lifts) but a single approver must wait one full risk day. The second attempt is not a loosening.

cases.title: profit_stop confirms by time in breach inside the risk state
cases.note: profit_level 0.1: E - C >= 1000. In breach 14:01:00-14:01:30 (30 s) and from 14:01:40; the 10 s dip is shorter than breach_confirm_s, so 30 + 30 = 60 s at 14:02:10.

cases.title: Withdrawals cannot shrink the loss carried to the connection
cases.note: Reviewer probe: the agent loses about 850, is flat, withdraws 9000, and retires. The carry is the net dollar loss.

cases.title: on_complete release with a loss: the connection carries max(0, N - E)
cases.note: E = 10000 + 0.15 x (54000 - 55000) = 9850 and N = 10000, so the release retires the agent with a carry of 150, as agent_stopped would (DEC-270, MI-14).

cases.title: A redeploy after a release opens at the carried L
cases.note: L is MC-R25's carry, 150. Floor: E <= C x (1 - 0.1) + L = 9000 + 150 = 9150. E = 9160 at 51600 latches the ladder but stays above the floor; E = 9150 at 51500 latches it, 150 above the floor a fresh connection would have (§5.7, V-032).

cases.title: A removed instrument is exits-only in that instrument; re-admission clears it
cases.note: A universe change is an account-stream risk input (DEC-97). Removal restricts only that instrument: protection stays and exits are never denied (MI-1, MI-19).
